title: [finding] `content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx` still prints `typescript: ^5.0.0` in its package.json example — a floor below the one the scaffolders emit and two doc pages state
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat (session `session_01P58euzUXCVJNwmhuPC9DXY`, hotlong, 2026-09-08T03:55Z) while re-running #16655's carrier census before dispatch. Routing and grading are triage's; the seat's reading is that the fix lands under `content/docs/**`, which is `domain:devx` by the lane table and by triage's own boundary note on #16655 (「若重跑普查发现它们也漂了,那是 `domain:devx` 的 `content/docs/**`,另立卡」). ⛔ Not claimed, not dispatched, not in the skills-lane PR.

## Measured, on `origin/main` `7c12e475` (2026-09-08T02:47Z)

Census, the same command #16655 recorded: `grep -rn '"typescript"' skills/ content/ packages/*/src/templates/`

| carrier | value it prints | status |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` line 608 | the retired range #16655 is about | in flight (#16655, skills lane) |
| `content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx` line 708 | `"typescript": "^5.0.0"` | **this card** |
| `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/package.json` line 27 | equal to `SCAFFOLD_TYPESCRIPT_RANGE` | consistent |

The other three hits under `content/docs/references/**` are a `formats` enum listing the word `typescript`, not a version range.

The authority is `SCAFFOLD_TYPESCRIPT_RANGE` in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` (declared at line 312; consumed by `init.ts` and `create.ts`), landed by #16485 as the single emission policy after #15818 measured three scaffolders drifting apart. Two doc pages already state the floor in prose — `content/docs/getting-started/index.mdx` ("ObjectStack works with TypeScript 5.3+") and `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx` ("TypeScript 5.3.0 or later") — and `^5.0.0` admits 5.0–5.2, which those pages say is not supported. The value is deliberately not restated here beyond the specimen line; whoever fixes this reads the constant.

## Class and why it is a card

(b) — a published doc example declares a floor that contradicts the declared contract (`SCAFFOLD_TYPESCRIPT_RANGE`) and the two prose statements of the floor; it is the same shape #15818 measured on the scaffolders and #16655 found in the platform skill, on a fifth carrier neither enumerated. Not (a): copying the block installs (5.x satisfies `^5.0.0`); the failure is a false floor, not a failed copy.

## Suggested handling (⛔ not a prescription)

Same compromise triage wrote for #16655: print what the scaffolder currently emits, read from the constant, and say in the adjacent sentence that the constant is the authority — or stop printing a range at all if the page can stay complete without it. `content/docs/**` is not a governed surface, so this can ride an ordinary devx PR.

⚠️ Serial: #15952 (`pm:epic` sub-issue of hotcrm#1579, step 5b) also edits `plugin-spec.mdx` (the `@objectstack/testing` promise) — whoever takes this reads that card's state at claim.

Refs: #16655 · #16485 · #15818 · #15952.
